posts.name: Closed Alpha 1
posts.intro: The first time players fought in The Great War.

sections.title: Bugs
items: Crawling didn't work with most guns.
Rifles sometimes wouldn't fire after a reload until you switched slots.
Some players' settings went back to the defaults after updating the pack.
The key bindings screen showed the wrong name for the gun controls.

sections.title: Suggested
items: An option to stop ammo moving into the hotbar by itself.
Gun upgrades, and guns that can jam.
Lanterns, doors, ladders, chairs and other decorations you can actually use.
Slimmer armour, and new tank sounds.
